images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, wide landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of the Atlantic coast at Porto das Dunas in Aquiraz, Ceara, Brazil. Broad gently curving pale-gold sandy beach with low rolling dunes, a small natural coastal coconut grove on landward side, turquoise-to-blue Atlantic water with realistic breaking surf, very few tiny distant beachgoers, distant modest resort buildings only and no identifiable invented landmarks. Bright tropical morning, spacious serene coastal travel scene, grounded aerial-oblique view at modest altitude, lush but realistic northeastern Brazil vegetation, no mountains, no Caribbean islands, no giant waterpark slides. Clear text-friendly sky and sandy space at left, premium natural travel photography, no text, watermark, border or collage.
